name: Thunder Bluff
summary: On Mulgore’s high mesas, Thunder Bluff shelters the tauren and gathers their scattered tribes. Cairne Bloodhoof founded the city after the Third War, giving them refuge and a place to keep their traditions.

sections.title: A Refuge Upon the Mesas
sections.body:
Above Mulgore, rope bridges join Thunder Bluff’s stone mesas, and wooden elevators carry travelers up from the plains. For generations, the tauren wandered central Kalimdor as centaur raiding parties pursued them. During the Third War, Cairne Bloodhoof joined Warchief Thrall and the New Horde.

Together, they drove back the centaurs and claimed Mulgore’s fertile grasslands. Cairne gathered the scattered tribes and founded the city atop the mesas. The heights offered shelter above the plains, along with a place for the tauren to trade and gather in worship.

sections.title: Unity and Gathering Mists
sections.body: Cairne Bloodhoof’s followers share Thunder Bluff with tauren who follow other ways. Magatha Grimtotem and her kin dwell on the Elder Rise. Beneath the city, spirit walkers and shaman seek the ancestors’ will at the Pools of Vision. Tribal rivalries persist, yet Thunder Bluff remains a spiritual pillar of Kalimdor’s Horde. Hunters return from the Barrens, artisans travel through, and druids come to commune with the Earth Mother.

faq.q: How do travelers get up to Thunder Bluff?
aliases: how to get up to tb
faq.answer: Wooden rope and pulley elevators on the southwestern and northeastern bluffs carry travelers up to Thunder Bluff. Others fly to the wind rider roost atop the central mesa.

faq.q: Why did the tauren build their city on cliffs?
faq.answer: After centuries of centaur raids across the open plains, Cairne Bloodhoof chose the stone mesas for a refuge above Mulgore’s sacred grazing grounds.
High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof leads Thunder Bluff. He united the scattered tribes and secured peace in Mulgore, with counsel from tribal leaders and elders across the rises.

faq.q: Are all tauren tribes loyal to Cairne?
faq.answer: Most tauren revere Cairne’s wisdom. Some tribes, especially the Grimtotem led by Magatha, doubt the Horde alliance and seek their own course for the tauren people.

angles.text: As a tauren, you find your first lasting home after generations of wandering in Thunder Bluff. Its sacred totems, spirit lodges, and greatest chieftains hold your people’s traditions.
As a member of the Horde, you have a stronghold in southern Kalimdor at Thunder Bluff. It offers wisdom and resources alongside Orgrimmar.
